Bundled NIBTools component

Author: Peter Rittwage and contributors; based on MNIB by Markus Brenner.
Official repository: https://github.com/rittwage/nibtools
Release tag: 20241120
Windows release build: r112924, AMD64 (64-bit)
Binary archive: nibtools-msvc-opencbm5-amd64-r112924.zip
Download: https://github.com/rittwage/nibtools/releases/download/20241120/nibtools-msvc-opencbm5-amd64-r112924.zip

nibconv.exe is unmodified from that official binary archive.
SHA-256: fba8b5cb386ec371e736487ac31247f73b8cdec910eafd87236026a5b364ccbb

The complete source snapshot published for the release is included as
NIBTools-source-20241120.zip (repository commit prefix 7bd2089).
Source download: https://api.github.com/repos/rittwage/nibtools/zipball/20241120
LICENSE.txt is the upstream repository's GPL-3.0 license text.
Original copyright and third-party notices remain in the source archive.

README-upstream.txt describes all NIBTools programs, including hardware
disk-reading/writing programs. This converter uses only nibconv.exe to
convert existing image files; the physical-drive setup is not needed.
